description_en: Heavy-duty drilling rigs engineered for surface applications with high torque hydraulic systems, modular designs, and ATEX-certified solutions for mining and geotechnical operations.

subcategories.description_en: The BullDrill Top-Head Drive series features robust construction designed for challenging field conditions, with user-friendly systems and mobile track capability.
subcategories.tagline_en: High torque, safe control, maximum efficiency.

subcategories.description_en: The BullDrill Spindle Drive series delivers superior performance in challenging field conditions, featuring a robust structure, 4-gear transmission, and gas-operated rod holder.
subcategories.tagline_en: Spindle drive, high precision, seamless control.

subcategories.description_en: Combines reverse circulation and diamond core drilling capabilities in a single platform, delivering flexibility, power, and reliability across different drilling methods.
subcategories.tagline_en: Dual mode, single platform, uninterrupted flexibility.

description_en: Compact, high-torque underground drilling rigs engineered for confined spaces, with electric motors, telescopic mast structures, and ATEX-certified ex-proof options.

subcategories.description_en: Compact underground drilling systems featuring ABB/SIEMENS electric motors, KAWASAKI hydraulic pumps, telescopic mast structure, and 360° drilling capability for confined space operations.
subcategories.tagline_en: Compact power, full control, maximum torque.

subcategories.description_en: Designed for challenging underground conditions with USTEC crawler track systems, high-torque spindle heads, PERKINS diesel tramming engine, and robust construction for maneuverability.
subcategories.tagline_en: Strong ground grip, full control, high torque.

subcategories.description_en: Türkiye's first and only ATEX-certified explosion-proof drilling rigs, designed for environments with methane emissions. Features CEMP/ABB Ex-proof motors, fire-resistant hydraulic tank, methane detector, and D-type explosion-proof electrical enclosure.
subcategories.tagline_en: Harsh environments, full protection, high performance.

description_en: High-performance drilling accessories and consumables manufactured from high-quality materials, ensuring exceptional durability and precision even in the hardest rock formations.

subcategories.description_en: Heat-treated drill rods and casings with high surface hardness and tough core for wireline and conventional drilling systems.
subcategories.tagline_en: Heat-treated for surface hardness and core toughness.

subcategories.description_en: Reliable and efficient sample recovery with single and double tube options across a wide diameter range.
subcategories.tagline_en: Reliable sample recovery across all diameters.

subcategories.description_en: TC-based tools designed for fast, efficient, and wear-resistant sample drilling in mineral exploration and geotechnical applications.

subcategories.description_en: Durable, stackable, and long-lasting core trays for field use, available in plastic and galvanised steel options.

subcategories.description_en: A water-cooled diamond-blade cutting system designed to cut core samples safely, quickly, and cleanly.

subcategories.description_en: Powerful flush pumps and mud mixers that ensure continuous circulation and optimal drilling fluid mixture during operations.
